title: Synthesis 18: C:motile-repair met by a crawler whose layer is its own; PPS reproduces from one motion law; open-endedness has a calibrated measure and no candidate
summary: Since 02:28: c31's wave-pinning crawler with a self-made layer meets C:motile-repair (IBWRM, audit pending), and a matched slow-diffusion twin loses its cargo (submitted); PPS is held SID from one motion law; ringswim repair is held SIB and the FCH chemoton SI; r-two56's individuation is beyond diffusion; the Lenia predator's persistence switches at about 224-256^2. The O measure now passes a moving-landscape positive control and rejects Hash Chemistry, evoloop and seeded BFF turnover once drift is matched. Next: crawler to C:contained-swimmers (S, D), nematic rods to C:swim-divide (travel between divisions), and O with a world-made moving target.
